audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1 and 2 were rated Skill despite a 57.37% win rate over 1417 games and text that describes Sett out-trading an immobile mage; level 4-5 was given outright to Ryze.
audit.why: Sett's double-punch passive and Knuckle Down beat Overload poke at level 1-2; by 4-5 Rune Prison is up often enough that neither side owns the stage.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 -> Sett, row 3 -> Skill, matching the already-audited mirror exactly. Proposed as full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: The four spikes already sit on the right timings: Facebreaker at 3, The Show Stopper at 6, first item, and Ryze's late-item scaling. Realm Warp's 180/160/140s cooldown is not a lane spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison was described everywhere as 'his point-blank root'. Riot's text says it damages and SLOWS; it roots only if Spell Flux (E) is already on the target.
audit.why: That is the decisive interaction of the lane — if you step in before his E lands, his W cannot lock you and your E-stun into a cashed Haymaker goes through.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t, with the 11s rank-1 W cooldown.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ryze.json (W text and cd 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, E cd 3.5-2.5)

audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1; Overload is 5s but resets off his other casts, so poke is effectively constant and only W is punishable.
audit.corrected: 11s added to the cooldown breakdown and whys[3].

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison (11s rank 1): it only roots if Spell Flux is on you — unfluxed it is just a slow, so step in before his E.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It roots only through Spell Flux — engage before his E lands and it is a slow you walk through.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — E-stun into the W panel.
edits.after: Track Ryze's Spell Flux, not just Rune Prison: unfluxed, his W only slows. Step in clean, E-stun, then cash the W panel.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you dominate a dashless mage who can only self-root to peel you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he answers with Rune Prison — 11s at rank 1, so trade when it's down.

notes: Chart rows 0/1/3 set to match the already-audited ryze__sett mirror rather than the packet chart, which claims Sett owns rows 0-5 outright; rows 2, 4, 5, 6 left as they stand so the two directions agree. Left untouched, per the mirror's note: spikes[1].text's claim that Ryze 'can't Realm Warp out of a flip' — suppression/displacement interaction is not in Riot's text and is recorded in unverified.
